title: DECLARE-TIMI58: Multicenter Trial to Evaluate the Effect of Dapagliflozin on the Incidence of Cardiovascular Events
condition: type 2 diabetes with high cardiovascular risk

criteria.sentence: Provision of informed consent prior to any study specific procedures

rule.unevaluable_reason: Informed consent is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Informed consent

rule.unevaluable_reason: The registry text does not define high cardiovascular risk, so the data cannot decide it
rule.label: High cardiovascular risk

criteria.sentence: Diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes mellitus History of bladder cancer or history of radiation therapy to the lower abdomen or pelvis at any time

rule.unevaluable_reason: Radiation history and cancer site are not recorded; the type 1 diabetes part shares this line, so it is not counted either
rule.label: Exclude type 1 diabetes, bladder cancer, or pelvic radiation

criteria.sentence: Chronic cystitis and/or recurrent urinary tract infections

rule.unevaluable_reason: Cystitis and urinary tract infections are not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude chronic cystitis or recurrent UTIs

rule.unevaluable_reason: Pregnancy and breast-feeding are not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude pregnancy or breast-feeding
